outputs.explanation: Body weight, LW/BW, and FW/BW are shown as scatter/bar plots with individual mouse data points (dots/squares) overlaid on the mean ± S.D. bars, n=5 per group.
This is a photograph of gross mouse anatomy, not a plot showing averaged data.
These are micrograph images (H&E and Oil Red O staining), not a plot showing averaged data.
This is a dot blot image (5mC and methylene blue staining), not a plot of averaged data.
The 5mC/methylene blue quantification bar chart displays individual data points (dots/squares) for each of the 5 mice per group overlaid on the mean ± S.D. bars.
The bottom bar chart quantifying TET1/TET2/TET3 over GAPDH shows individual data points (dots/squares) for each animal overlaid on the mean ± S.D. bars, n=6 NC, n=7 HFD.
